event_name: Captain Jindong/Rocky Ridge & One Drop Tap Takeover
date_text: Thu, Jul 30th • 12:00 PM AEST - Sun, Aug 2nd • 10:00 PM AEST
description: 🌍⚡ Captain Jindong V2 Lands at Hotel Sweeney’s ⚡🌍 Rocky Ridge Brewing’s Captain Jindong V2 is taking over the taps – a beer inspired by everyone’s favourite environmental superhero. With the powers of Earth, Fire, Wind, Water, Heart... and Captain Jindong, this cult favourite returns in its second incarnation, bringing all six elements together in one epic collaboration. But we’re not stopping there. Joining Captain Jindong are six heavenly beers from One Drop Brewing, creating a tap lineup that’s packed with fresh releases, big flavours and plenty of surprises. Tap List:- • Water: Guava Habanero Berliner Sour (4.2% ABV) • Earth: Juicy NEIPA (5.8% ABV) • Wind: DDH Hazy IPA (6.2% ABV) • Fire: Classic West Coast IPA (8.0% ABV) • Heart: Chocolate Raspberry White Stout (6.0% ABV) • Captain Jindong v2: TDH Cali Triple IPA (9.0% ABV) • One Drop, Svaki Dan, Peanut Butter & Banoffee Pie Imp Stout (10.4%) • One Drop, Dividend$, Oat Cream IPA (6.2%) • One Drop, All Day, Cream Pastry Stout (8%) • One Drop, The Countdown, Saturated DDH DIPA (8%) • One Drop, Summer Baddie, Cream Smoothie Sour (6%) • One Drop, Angel Falls, DDH DIPA (7.8%)
